def test_quoted_preferences_update_beliefs_once_and_preserve_uncertainty():
    case, ref, sup = sample()
    b = Beliefs(case, ref, sup)
    before = b.summary()['b_pay']['mean']
    signals = [{'kind': 'early_payment', 'quote': 'We need earlier payment.'}]
    assert b.apply_evidence(signals) == ['early_payment']
    assert b.summary()['b_pay']['mean'] > before
    weights = [p.weight for p in b.particles]
    assert not b.apply_evidence(signals)
    assert weights == [p.weight for p in b.particles]
    assert all(p.weight > 0 for p in b.particles)


def test_fixed_terms_cannot_be_reopened_by_supplier_hint():
    result = Router.validate({'interpretations': [], 'ambiguities': [], 'signals': [
        {'kind': 'early_payment', 'source_id': 'reply', 'quote': 'pay sooner'}
    ]}, {'reply': 'Please pay sooner.'}, ['unit_price', 'ppm_commitment'])
    assert result['signals'] == []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='unsupported signal'):
        Router.validate({'interpretations': [], 'ambiguities': [], 'signals': [
            {'kind': 'capacity_limit', 'source_id': 'reply', 'quote': 'invented'}
        ]}, {'reply': 'Please pay sooner.'})


def test_all_supplier_sheets_are_compared(tmp_path):
    case, ref, _ = sample()
    opening = {'from': 'supplier', 'status': 'open', 'term_sheets': [
        {'term_sheet_id': 'opening', 'terms': {**ref, 'unit_price': 100}}
    ]}
    agent = AnalyticalAgent(store=Store(tmp_path / 'offers.sqlite'))
    agent.start(case, {'sup': [opening]})
    reply = {'from': 'supplier', 'status': 'final_offer', 'term_sheets': [
        {'term_sheet_id': 'expensive', 'terms': {**ref, 'unit_price': 99}},
        {'term_sheet_id': 'better', 'terms': {**ref, 'unit_price': 90}}
    ]}
    offers = agent.available(case, {'sup': [opening, reply]}, 1e12)
    assert [o[2] for o in offers] == ['better', 'expensive']
    action = agent.decide(case, {'sup': [opening, reply]})['message']['action']
    assert action['term_sheet_id'] == 'better'


def test_reply_interpretation_changes_beliefs_before_offer_ranking(tmp_path):
    case, ref, _ = sample()
    case['negotiable'] = ['unit_price', 'payment_days']
    case['fixed_terms'].pop('payment_days', None)
    case['term_options']['payment_days'] = [14, 60]
    event = {'from': 'supplier', 'status': 'open', 'body': 'Please pay sooner.',
             'term_sheets': [{'term_sheet_id': 'opening', 'terms': ref}]}
    class EvidenceRouter:
        enabled = True
        calls = []
        def analyse(self, *args, **kwargs):
            return {'signals': [{'kind': 'early_payment', 'quote': 'pay sooner'}], 'ambiguities': []}
    agent = AnalyticalAgent(store=Store(tmp_path / 'coupling.sqlite'), router=EvidenceRouter())
    original = agent.rank
    observed = []
    def rank(*args):
        observed.append(args[1].beliefs.signal_counts.get('early_payment'))
        return original(*args)
    agent.rank = rank
    agent.decide(case, {'sup': [event]})
    assert observed == [1]

    case, ref, _ = sample()
    case['negotiable'] = ['unit_price', 'payment_days']
    case['term_options']['payment_days'] = [14, 60]
    case['fixed_terms'].pop('payment_days', None)
    event = {'from': 'supplier', 'status': 'open', 'term_sheets': [{'term_sheet_id': 'x', 'terms': ref}]}
    agent = AnalyticalAgent(store=Store(tmp_path / 'search.sqlite'))

def test_regularised_learning_survives_restart(tmp_path):
    case, ref, sup = sample()
    b = Beliefs(case, ref, sup)
    before = b.accept_bias
    b.update('reply', [ref], 'counter', ref['unit_price'])
    assert b.accept_bias < before
    path = tmp_path / 'memory.sqlite'
    store = Store(path)
    store.save_learning('sup', 'goal', b.export_learning())
    store.close()
    store = Store(path)

    B --> C[Validate sources and permitted terms]

## Supplier estimates and learning

Each supplier starts with 64 reproducible, weighted scenarios. Priors are modelling assumptions, not calibrated facts.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `r` | Acceptance threshold in EUR/unit at reference terms; distinct from production cost |
| `b_pay` | Value of receiving payment 30 days earlier |
| `b_term` | Value of 12 extra contract months; can be negative |

| `b_quality` | Cost of tightening the quality commitment by 1,000 ppm |
| `b_capacity` | Sensitivity to volume above the latest offered allocation |
| `full_cost` | Uncertain production cost used by the published sustainability penalty |

A source-backed preference weakly reweights scenarios, by at most a 2:1 likelihood ratio per statement, with duplicate suppression and at most two signals of each kind per session. Explicit long-commitment evidence permits a modest, assumed reduction of the capacity uplift penalty. None of this establishes a physical capacity limit or guarantees additional allocation.

Actual accept/counter/walk outcomes reweight scenarios with a tempered likelihood. A regularised online update adjusts walk intercept, pressure slope, repeat slope and acceptance bias. Prediction probabilities and multiclass Brier errors are logged. These updates make assumptions responsive; a few observations do not make them statistically calibrated.

`learned_models` stores normalised preference means and response estimates. Subsequent sessions blend 25% of an existing supplier estimate or 10% of a category estimate into new priors, preserving scenario spread. Only models with observed responses are reused. Current production costs and capacities are not copied between suppliers. Known buyer costs for quality, delivery and financing come directly from the case; they are not replaced by invented learned weights. No Qwen weights are trained.

## Offer search and closure

Enumerate reference and one-field changes plus up to 600 complete packages from the starter kit. Search a price grid from 20% below to 15% above the current quote, with additional prices derived from estimated supplier value and a concession increment. Prices remain within a bounded exploration range. Premiums can buy better non-price terms. This is a bounded heuristic, not a global optimiser.

Evaluate every candidate when there are at most 1,200. Above that, retain central expected-value candidates, cheap candidates, high-acceptance candidates and representatives across packages. The initial v2 pruning experiment missed useful intermediate prices; this broader selection fixed the observed local regression before hosted testing.

After a counteroffer, require a meaningful improvement in estimated supplier package value. Track unchanged supplier responses and include a small cost for another stalled round. Compare **every** currently offered term sheet across live suppliers, check must-haves, and accept the best admissible sheet by its exact ID. A closing thread does not force closure while other suppliers remain negotiable.

The objective is expected deal/counter/fallback cost plus 0.25 times the standard deviation of scenario expected costs.
